name: Enbridge Inc. Preferred Shares (ENB.PR.N)
summary: Enbridge Inc. is an energy infrastructure company operating through five segments. Liquids Pipelines manages pipelines and terminals moving crude oil and other liquid hydrocarbons across Canada and the United States. Gas Transmission and Midstream invests in natural gas pipelines and gathering and processing facilities in both countries, and Gas Distribution and Storage covers gas utility activities.
